info.description: FACT-ONLY partial specification. Every path has x-evidence; every non-obvious field carries [RUN]/[STATIC]/[ASSUMED] in its description. The 14 unittest cases check internal consistency (envelope, array shapes, required keys) and DO NOT prove client compatibility. Client compatibility is proven only by a live run with server/requests.jsonl + logcat. Quest schema: spec/quest_protocol.md. Coverage matrix: docs/protocol_coverage.md.
